name: NVD (National Vulnerability Database)
gives: CVE records with CVSS, CPE, CWE; CVE API 2.0

why.quote: The software developed by NIST employees is not subject to copyright protection within the United States.
why.basis: NIST copyright page (general NIST site, not an NVD-specific terms page)

interface: CVE API 2.0 (services.nvd.nist.gov); rate limits not read.
notes: NVD's own developers and terms pages are script-rendered (only a shell was returned), so the API terms and rate limits were NOT read; check them before collecting. NIST's general page also says NIST gives no warranty on the data. Aggregate-only use (counts by vendor or severity) fits on this evidence; CVE records are not personal data.
